newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian '97 GDP to grow at least two pct-Cen.bank.
newsitem.headline: Belgian '97 GDP to grow at least two pct-Cen.bank.

text.p: Belgian central bank governor Alfons Verplaetse said he expected Belgian Gross Domestic Product to grow by at least two percent in 1997 from 1.4 percent in 1996.
"I see no reason why we would not have growth of at least two percent this year," he told a news conference on the bank's annual report on Wednesday. His remarks were embargoed for release on Friday.
In its autumn 1996 forecasts the European Union saw 1997 GDP growing at 2.2 percent.
Asked whether the recent fall of the central bank's leading indicator could herald a recession this year, Verplaetse said "All the conditions are in place to avoid this possibility."
